integrity: All unrestricted set-theoretic quandle homomorphisms are classified in a proved normal form; no external or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the rank-one unipotent length-two Jordan block over an elementary abelian additive group; it does not count arbitrary subquandles or prove historical priority. Its finite checker corroborates but does not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: Retraction images and exact rank census for rank-one unipotent Alexander quandles
